# RedRouter: Text-to-Speech

Requires `RED_ROUTER_BASE_URL` and, when the instance requires one, `RED_ROUTER_API_KEY`. See
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/reddb-io/red-router/main/skills/red-router/SKILL.md for setup.

## Discover

```bash
# Speech models (audio entries with subtype "speech")
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $RED_ROUTER_API_KEY" $RED_ROUTER_BASE_URL/v1/models \
  | jq '.data[] | select(.type=="audio" and .subtype=="speech") | .id'
# Per-model metadata
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $RED_ROUTER_API_KEY" "$RED_ROUTER_BASE_URL/v1/models/info?id=<model-id>"
# Voices for providers with a voice catalog: elevenlabs, deepgram, inworld, edge-tts (optional lang)
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $RED_ROUTER_API_KEY" "$RED_ROUTER_BASE_URL/v1/audio/voices?provider=edge-tts&lang=en"
```

The `model` field of `/v1/audio/speech` is a `provider/model` id. Some providers encode the voice
in it (for example `provider/voice-id`); `/v1/models/info` and `/v1/audio/voices` show which.

## Endpoint

`POST $RED_ROUTER_BASE_URL/v1/audio/speech`

| Field | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `model` | yes | speech model or voice id from discovery |
| `input` | yes | text to speak |

Other OpenAI-style fields (such as `voice` or `response_format`) are accepted and passed to
providers that support them.

## Example

```bash
curl -X POST $RED_ROUTER_BASE_URL/v1/audio/speech \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RED_ROUTER_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"<model-id>","input":"Hello world"}' \
  --output speech.mp3
```

JS (save file):

```js
import { writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";
const r = await fetch(`${process.env.RED_ROUTER_BASE_URL}/v1/audio/speech`, {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.RED_ROUTER_API_KEY}`,
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({ model: "<model-id>", input: "Hello world" }),
});
await writeFile("speech.mp3", Buffer.from(await r.arrayBuffer()));
```

## Response shape

The body is raw audio bytes; check the `Content-Type` response header (usually `audio/mpeg`).
A failure returns a JSON error object with a non-2xx status.
